// =========================================================
// 7_Prepare – Merged Context
// =========================================================
// Builds the unified context object consumed by Node 8 (orchestrator)
// and all downstream email/call branches.
//
// Multi-line PO grouping (comms_group_id):
//   - The representative row is the row with earliest ship_by_date_delivery_1.
//     (Identified upstream by Node 4a_Pick Representative Row.)
//   - All stage state, dates, and identity fields are sourced from the
//     representative row.
//   - A group_line_items[] array carries per-line-item details for use in
//     email prompts that render multi-line PO Details sections.
// =========================================================

// --- 1. Pull single-row references ---
const representative = $('4a_Pick Representative Row').first().json;
const bandConfig = $('5_Read – Band Config').first().json;
const clientConfig = $('6_Read – Client Company Name').first().json;

// --- 2. Pull multi-row references ---
const commsLogRows = $('2_Read – Communication Logs Row').all().map(i => i.json);
const poRows = $('3_Read – PO Details').all().map(i => i.json);
const supplierRows = $('4_Read – Supplier Details').all().map(i => i.json);

// --- 3. Find representative's comms log row by po_line_key ---
const repKey = representative.po_line_key;
const commsLog = commsLogRows.find(r => r.po_line_key === repKey);
if (!commsLog) {
  throw new Error(
    `7_Prepare – Merged Context: no Communication Logs row matches representative po_line_key ${repKey}`
  );
}

// --- 4. Build group_line_items[] ---
// One entry per line item in the group. Each entry pairs PO details
// with supplier+material details by (supplier_code, material_code).
// Sorted by po_line_item ascending so emails render line items in
// natural order (10, 20, 30, 40).
const groupLineItems = poRows
  .slice()
  .sort((a, b) => Number(a.po_line_item) - Number(b.po_line_item))
  .map(po => {
    const supplierMatch = supplierRows.find(
      s => s.supplier_code === po.supplier_code && s.material_code === po.material_code
    );
    // Per-line comms log row for stage-specific reply data
    const lineCommsLog = commsLogRows.find(r => r.po_line_key === po.po_line_key) || {};

    return {
      // Identity & PO-level
      po_line_key: po.po_line_key,
      po_line_item: po.po_line_item,
      material_code: po.material_code,
      material_name: po.material_name,
      quantity: po.quantity,
      unit_of_measure: po.unit_of_measure,
      deliver_by_date: po.deliver_by_date_delivery_1,
      ship_by_date: po.ship_by_date_delivery_1,
      // Supplier contact (per-line in master schema)
      supplier_contact_name: supplierMatch?.primary_contact_names,
      supplier_email: supplierMatch?.primary_emails,
      supplier_phone: supplierMatch?.primary_phones,
      // Per-line reply data — Stage 1
      stage1_supplier_reply_status: lineCommsLog.stage1_supplier_reply_status,
      stage1_supplier_raw_statement: lineCommsLog.stage1_supplier_raw_statement,
      stage1_delivery_status_classification: lineCommsLog.stage1_delivery_status_classification,
      stage1_delivery_status_text: lineCommsLog.stage1_delivery_status_text,
      stage1_reply_timestamp: lineCommsLog.stage1_reply_timestamp,
      // Per-line reply data — Stage 1.5
      stage1_5_supplier_reply_status: lineCommsLog.stage1_5_supplier_reply_status,
      stage1_5_supplier_raw_statement: lineCommsLog.stage1_5_supplier_raw_statement,
      stage1_5_delivery_status_classification: lineCommsLog.stage1_5_delivery_status_classification,
      stage1_5_delivery_status_text: lineCommsLog.stage1_5_delivery_status_text,
      stage1_5_reply_timestamp: lineCommsLog.stage1_5_reply_timestamp,
      // Per-line reply data — Stage 2
      stage2_supplier_reply_status: lineCommsLog.stage2_supplier_reply_status,
      stage2_supplier_raw_statement: lineCommsLog.stage2_supplier_raw_statement,
      stage2_delivery_status_classification: lineCommsLog.stage2_delivery_status_classification,
      stage2_delivery_status_text: lineCommsLog.stage2_delivery_status_text,
      stage2_reply_timestamp: lineCommsLog.stage2_reply_timestamp,
      // Per-line reply data — Stage 2.5
      stage2_5_supplier_reply_status: lineCommsLog.stage2_5_supplier_reply_status,
      stage2_5_supplier_raw_statement: lineCommsLog.stage2_5_supplier_raw_statement,
      stage2_5_delivery_status_classification: lineCommsLog.stage2_5_delivery_status_classification,
      stage2_5_delivery_status_text: lineCommsLog.stage2_5_delivery_status_text,
      stage2_5_reply_timestamp: lineCommsLog.stage2_5_reply_timestamp,
      // Per-line reply data — Stage 3
      stage3_supplier_reply_status: lineCommsLog.stage3_supplier_reply_status,
      stage3_supplier_raw_statement: lineCommsLog.stage3_supplier_raw_statement,
      stage3_delivery_status_classification: lineCommsLog.stage3_delivery_status_classification,
      stage3_delivery_status_text: lineCommsLog.stage3_delivery_status_text,
      stage3_reply_timestamp: lineCommsLog.stage3_reply_timestamp,
    };
  });

// --- 5. Return merged context ---
return [{
  json: {
    // ---------- Group identity ----------
    comms_group_id: representative.comms_group_id,
    group_size: groupLineItems.length,
    group_line_items: groupLineItems,

    // ---------- Representative identity ----------
    po_line_key: representative.po_line_key,
    po_number: representative.po_number,
    po_line_item: representative.po_line_item,
    supplier_code: representative.supplier_code,

    material_code: representative.material_code,
    material_name: representative.material_name,
    quantity: representative.quantity,
    unit_of_measure: representative.unit_of_measure,

    // ---------- Representative PO dates ----------

    deliver_by_date: representative.deliver_by_date_delivery_1,

function isEmpty(val) {
  return !val || String(val).trim() === '';
}

// Fix prefix for Stage1.5 and Stage2.5
function parseWorkingDays(config) {
  if (!config) return [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6];
  const dayMap = { 'Mon': 1, 'Tue': 2, 'Wed': 3, 'Thu': 4, 'Fri': 5, 'Sat': 6, 'Sun': 0 };
  return config.split(',').map(d => dayMap[d.trim()]).filter(d => d !== undefined);
}

function countWorkingDaysSince(fromTimestamp, workingDays, testMode) {
  if (!fromTimestamp || String(fromTimestamp).trim() === '') return -1;
  if (testMode) {
    const from = new Date(fromTimestamp);
    const now = new Date();
    return (now - from) / 60000;
  }
  const from = new Date(fromTimestamp);
  const now = new Date();
  from.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  now.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  if (now <= from) return 0;
  let count = 0;
  const cursor = new Date(from);
  cursor.setDate(cursor.getDate() + 1);
  while (cursor <= now) {
    if (workingDays.includes(cursor.getDay())) count++;
    cursor.setDate(cursor.getDate() + 1);
  }
  return count;
}

  calls_enabled:           d.calls_enabled,
  email_send_mode_direct_or_draft: d.email_send_mode_direct_or_draft,
  test_mode:               testMode,
  outreach_message_id:                   ctx.outreach_message_id,
  delivery_status_classification:        ctx.delivery_status_classification,
  delivery_status_text:                  ctx.delivery_status_text,
  supplier_raw_statement:                ctx.supplier_raw_statement,
  supplier_reply_message_id:             ctx.supplier_reply_message_id,
  reply_timestamp:                       ctx.reply_timestamp,
  mode_of_reply_received:                ctx.mode_of_reply_received,
  outreach_body:                         ctx.outreach_body,
  reminder_mail1_body:                   ctx.reminder_mail1_body,
  reminder_mail2_body:                   ctx.reminder_mail2_body,
  reminder_mail3_body:                   ctx.reminder_mail3_body,
  supplier_reply_thread_id: d.supplier_reply_thread_id || ctx.supplier_reply_thread_id || '',
  outreach_thread_id:                    ctx.outreach_thread_id,
  supplier_colleague_email:              ctx.supplier_colleague_email,
  ...priorHistory,
};

// ============================================================
// BLOCK 0.5 — Freeze Guard (Human Review)
// ============================================================

if (d.needs_human_review === 'Yes' || d.needs_human_review === true) {
  return [{ json: { ...baseOutput, action: 'no_action', message: 'Paused for Human Review' }}];
}

// Get promised revert date directly from context
const promisedRevertDateStr = ctx.promised_revert_date || null;

// Virtual Outreach Timestamp to handle clarification gap resets safely
const virtualOutreachTimestamp = !isEmpty(ctx.clarification_sent_timestamp) 
  ? ctx.clarification_sent_timestamp 
  : ctx.outreach_timestamp;

const daysSinceE1 = countWorkingDaysSince(virtualOutreachTimestamp, workingDays, testMode);

// ============================================================
// BLOCK 1 — Reply received, acknowledgment/clarification pending
// ============================================================

const ackStatus = ctx.acknowledgment_sent || '';
const isAckPending = ackStatus === '' || ackStatus.startsWith('Clarification');

if (ctx.supplier_reply_status === 'Received' && isAckPending) {
  const classification = ctx.delivery_status_classification;
  
  if (classification === 'awaiting_reply') {
    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // TYPE A & TYPE B (awaiting_reply)
    // --------------------------------------------------------
    if (promisedRevertDateStr) {
      // Type B: Promised Date timing check (Wait until promised date)
      if (testMode) {
        const replyDate = new Date(ctx.reply_timestamp);
        const promisedDate = new Date(promisedRevertDateStr);
        replyDate.setHours(0,0,0,0);
        promisedDate.setHours(0,0,0,0);
        const daysDiff = Math.max(0, Math.round((promisedDate - replyDate) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)));
        const minutesSinceReply = (now - new Date(ctx.reply_timestamp)) / 60000;
        
        if (minutesSinceReply < daysDiff) {
          return [{ json: { ...baseOutput, action: 'no_action', message: `Supplier promised to check/revert by ${promisedRevertDateStr}. Waiting for ${daysDiff} minutes in test mode.` }}];
        }
      } else {
        const todayDateOnly = new Date(now);
        todayDateOnly.setHours(0,0,0,0);
        const promisedDateOnly = new Date(promisedRevertDateStr);
        promisedDateOnly.setHours(0,0,0,0);

        if (todayDateOnly < promisedDateOnly) {
          return [{ json: { ...baseOutput, action: 'no_action', message: `Supplier promised to check/revert by ${promisedRevertDateStr}. Waiting.` }}];
        }
      }
    }
    
    // Type A: Delegation has NO GRACE PERIOD - immediately falls through to standard reminders!
    // Type B: Promised Date   } else if (classification === 'unclear') {
    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // TYPE C (unclear)
    // --------------------------------------------------------
    if (ackStatus === '') {
      // Send 1st Clarification Immediately (no wait)
      return [{ json: { ...baseOutput, action: 'send_clarification1', message: `${stage} — unclear reply, sending clarification 1 immediately` }}];
    }
    
    // Once Clarification 1 is sent, no grace period is given.
    // The chaser resumes immediately on the next run by falling through.
  }${stage} — unclear fallback escalation` }}];
    }
  } else {
    // Clear reply -> send acknowledgment
    return [{ json: { ...baseOutput, action: 'send_acknowledgment', message: 'Supplier replied — acknowledgment not yet sent' }}];
  }
}

// BLOCK 1b — Stage 1.5
if (ctx.stage1_5_supplier_reply_status === 'Received' && isEmpty(ctx.stage1_5_acknowledgment_sent)) {
  return [{ json: { 
    ...baseOutput, 
    action: 'send_acknowledgment', 
    message: 'Stage 1.5 supplier reply — acknowledgment not yet sent', 
    supplier_raw_statement: d.stage1_5_supplier_raw_statement, 
    delivery_status_classification: d.stage1_5_delivery_status_classification,
    mode_of_reply_received: d.stage1_5_mode_of_reply_received
  }}];
}

// BLOCK 1c — Stage 2.5
if (ctx.stage2_5_supplier_reply_status === 'Received' && isEmpty(ctx.stage2_5_acknowledgment_sent)) {
  return [{ json: { 
    ...baseOutput, 
    action: 'send_acknowledgment', 
    message: 'Stage 2.5 supplier reply — acknowledgment not yet sent', 
    supplier_raw_statement: d.stage2_5_supplier_raw_statement, 
    delivery_status_classification: d.stage2_5_delivery_status_classification,
    mode_of_reply_received: d.stage2_5_mode_of_reply_received
  }}];
}

// ============================================================
// BLOCK 2 — Reply received, acknowledgment already sent
// ============================================================

if (ctx.supplier_reply_status === 'Received' && !isAckPending) {
  return [{ json: { ...baseOutput, action: 'acknowledgment_sent', message: 'Supplier replied and acknowledgment already sent' }}];
}

// ============================================================
// BLOCK 3 — Stage 1.5 and Stage 2.5 monitoring
// ============================================================

if (stage === 'Stage1.5') {
  return [{ json: { ...baseOutput, action: 'stage1_5_monitoring', message: 'Stage 1.5 — monitoring period, no active follow-up' }}];
}

if (stage === 'Stage2.5') {
  return [{ json: { ...baseOutput, action: 'stage2_5_monitoring', message: 'Stage 2.5 — monitoring period, no active follow-up' }}];
}

// ============================================================
// BLOCK 4 — No outreach sent yet, band says send it
// ============================================================

if (isEmpty(ctx.outreach_sent) && band.outreach_email === 'Yes') {
  return [{ json: { ...baseOutput, action: 'send_outreach', message: `${stage} — no outreach sent yet, sending now` }}];
}

// ============================================================
// BLOCK 6 & 7 — Reminder 1 email
// ============================================================

if (band.reminder1_email === 'Yes' && isEmpty(ctx.reminder_mail1_sent)) {
  if (daysSinceE1 < band.gap_e1_e2) {
    return [{ json: { ...baseOutput, action: 'too_early', message: `Too early for reminder 1 — ${testMode ? daysSinceE1.toFixed(2) + ' of ' + band.gap_e1_e2 + ' minutes' : daysSinceE1 + ' of ' + band.gap_e1_e2 + ' working days'} elapsed since outreach` }}];
  }
  return [{ json: { ...baseOutput, action: 'send_reminder1_email', message: `${stage} — sending reminder 1 email` }}];
}

// ============================================================
// BLOCK 8 & 9 — Reminder 2 email
// ============================================================

if (band.reminder2_email === 'Yes' && isEmpty(ctx.reminder_mail2_sent)) {
  if (daysSinceE1 < band.gap_e1_e3) {
    return [{ json: { ...baseOutput, action: 'too_early', message: `Too early for reminder 2 — ${testMode ? daysSinceE1.toFixed(2) + ' of ' + band.gap_e1_e3 + ' minutes' : daysSinceE1 + ' of ' + band.gap_e1_e3 + ' working days'} elapsed since outreach` }}];
  }
  return [{ json: { ...baseOutput, action: 'send_reminder2_email', message: `${stage} — sending reminder 2 email` }}];
}

// ============================================================
// BLOCK 10 & 11 — Reminder 3 email
// ============================================================

if (band.reminder3_email === 'Yes' && isEmpty(ctx.reminder_mail3_sent)) {
  if (daysSinceE1 < band.gap_e1_e4) {
    return [{ json: { ...baseOutput, action: 'too_early', message: `Too early for reminder 3 — ${testMode ? daysSinceE1.toFixed(2) + ' of ' + band.gap_e1_e4 + ' minutes' : daysSinceE1 + ' of ' + band.gap_e1_e4 + ' working days'} elapsed since outreach` }}];
  }
  return [{ json: { ...baseOutput, action: 'send_reminder3_email', message: `${stage} — sending reminder 3 email` }}];
}

// ============================================================
// BLOCK 12 & 13 — Call 1
// ============================================================

if (band.call1 === 'Yes' && isEmpty(ctx.reminder_call1_sent) && d.calls_enabled === 'Yes') {
  if (daysSinceE1 < band.gap_e1_c1) {
    return [{ json: { ...baseOutput, action: 'too_early', message: `Too early for call 1 — ${testMode ? daysSinceE1.toFixed(2) + ' of ' + band.gap_e1_c1 + ' minutes' : daysSinceE1 + ' of ' + band.gap_e1_c1 + ' working days'} elapsed since outreach` }}];
  }
  return [{ json: { ...baseOutput, action: 'make_call1', message: `${stage} — making call 1` }}];
}

// ============================================================
// BLOCK 14 & 15 — Call 2
// ============================================================

if (band.call2 === 'Yes' && isEmpty(ctx.reminder_call2_sent) && d.calls_enabled === 'Yes') {
  if (daysSinceE1 < band.gap_e1_c2) {
    return [{ json: { ...baseOutput, action: 'too_early', message: `Too early for call 2 — ${testMode ? daysSinceE1.toFixed(2) + ' of ' + band.gap_e1_c2 + ' minutes' : daysSinceE1 + ' of ' + band.gap_e1_c2 + ' working days'} elapsed since outreach` }}];
  }
  return [{ json: { ...baseOutput, action: 'make_call2', message: `${stage} — making call 2` }}];
}

// ============================================================
// BLOCK 16 & 17 — Call 3
// ============================================================

if (band.call3 === 'Yes' && isEmpty(ctx.reminder_call3_sent) && d.calls_enabled === 'Yes') {
  if (daysSinceE1 < band.gap_e1_c3) {
    return [{ json: { ...baseOutput, action: 'too_early', message: `Too early for call 3 — ${testMode ? daysSinceE1.toFixed(2) + ' of ' + band.gap_e1_c3 + ' minutes' : daysSinceE1 + ' of ' + band.gap_e1_c3 + ' working days'} elapsed since outreach` }}];
  }
  return [{ json: { ...baseOutput, action: 'make_call3', message: `${stage} — making call 3` }}];
}

// ============================================================
// BLOCK 18 & 19 — Escalation
// ============================================================

if (isEmpty(ctx.internal_escalation_sent)) {
  if (daysSinceE1 < band.gap_e1_escalation) {
    return [{ json: { ...baseOutput, action: 'too_early', message: `Too early for escalation — ${testMode ? daysSinceE1.toFixed(2) + ' of ' + band.gap_e1_escalation + ' minutes' : daysSinceE1 + ' of ' + band.gap_e1_escalation + ' working days'} elapsed since outreach` }}];
  }
  return [{ json: { ...baseOutput, action: 'escalate_to_buyer', message: `${stage} — sending escalation to buyer` }}];
}

// ============================================================
// BLOCK 20 — Fully escalated
// ============================================================

return [{ json: { ...baseOutput, action: 'fully_escalated', message: `${stage} — all actions exhausted, manual intervention required` }}];
